hero.badge: Live on Kubernetes · Powered by Argo Workflows
hero.title: Deploy AI agents.
hero.lede: Ranch is your agent deployment platform. Spin up containerized AI workers on a managed k3s cluster and chat with them in real time — no DevOps required.

demo.agent_greeting: Hi! I'm ready to help you ship.
demo.user_request: Deploy a new worker to staging.

landing.what_title: Infrastructure for AI agents, built on Kubernetes
landing.what_lede: From image to running pod to live chat — Ranch handles the plumbing so you can focus on what your agents should actually do.
landing.how_title: From template to conversation in three steps
landing.cta_lede: Jump into the dashboard, pick an agent, and start a conversation.

features.templates_body: Pick a Docker image, pin CPU/memory, and Ranch submits an Argo Workflow that rolls out your agent pod.
features.chat_body: Every running agent is reachable through a JWT-auth Socket.IO gateway with streaming responses.
features.status_body: Deploying, running, failed, stopped — Ranch tracks the workflow phase and surfaces it in the UI.
features.restart_body: Cancel the workflow, flip the image tag, and restart — Ranch keeps the agent record intact.
features.logs_body: Tail agent logs straight from the pod without jumping into kubectl.
features.admin_body: An admin surface to manage templates, users, quotas, and the whole fleet across the cluster.

steps.template_body: Browse ready-made agent images or register your own. Templates carry default resources and config.
steps.deploy_body: Ranch submits an Argo Workflow to your k3s cluster. You get a status stream back in the dashboard.
steps.chat_body: The agent connects to the bridle hub. Open the chat, send a message, watch it stream back.
